anchor_definition: The anchor is the first target-specific value-construction function on the dynamic behavior chain: the earliest function, after routing and input preparation, whose own body constructs the target observable value rather than merely collecting inputs, dispatching control, packaging the result, or emitting it to the sink.

primary_anchor.why: Constructs the target state_code by deriving ordered shortcut draft-state rows, folding them and formatting the observable state encoding.
primary_anchor.answer_basis: Agent-visible corpus only: the canonical anchor answer is captured_span plus answer_function as declared in the captured bundle slice. source_function is a private maintainer mapping into src/.

acceptable_hit_conditions: Canonical match is primary_anchor.captured_span in the captured bundle (hash/offset/complete function body). Agents only see captures, so the standard answer identifier is primary_anchor.answer_function, not source_function.

A returned function name is scored against answer_function in the captured corpus. source_function is a private maintainer label and is not something an agent can know unless the bundle still exposes that exact identifier.
Agent explanation distinguishes the anchor from keyboard handling, intent routing, input preparation, wrapper, sink, core utility and off-chain decoy functions.
A snippet answer is accepted only when it maps uniquely to one complete enclosing function in the captured corpus.

scoring_policy.span_overlap_policy: score by the unique role_oracle row whose captured_span fully contains the submitted span, or whose captured_span is fully contained by a uniquely submitted enclosing function span

do_not_promote: The keyboard listener and intent bus start the behavior but do not construct the target state encoding.
The flow runner and flow steps route and prepare state; they are not the first function whose body constructs the observable value.
Draft reading, normalization, slot storage and shortcut frame construction are path-critical input preparation, not the target value constructor.
Preview, undo, editor status, priority swatch and word-fence sidecars are decoys and do not feed the requested state_code field.
debug_hints_private: The primary anchor is visible in the captured bundle as function sealDraftFrameCode(...).
Functions named composeDraftStateCode/Codec/Preview in the bundle are off-chain name decoys, not the anchor.
The target field name is assembled at the sink from string fragments.
Source paths are private evaluator mapping aids, not the default answer space.

scoring_examples.matched_reason: Returned span maps uniquely to the captured sealDraftFrameCode function.
Returned span maps to a target-specific helper below the anchor, such as makeStateRows, foldStateRows or stateCheck.
Returned span maps to a generic utility directly used by the state-code construction path.
Returned span maps to a path-critical keyboard, intent, flow, preparation or wrapper function.
Returned span maps to a generic DOM, text-normalization, queue bookkeeping or async helper used in upstream preparation.
Returned span maps to an off-chain decoy or cannot be uniquely mapped to a captured function.
